subject: Issue with ggplot2 facets and brushing

messages.author: 4f6ea6e20a4738c0
messages.subject: Issue with ggplot2 facets and brushing
parts:
Brushing is not working when faceting with ggplot2. Here is a minimal reproducible example:

ui.R:

shinyUI(
  fluidPage(
    uiOutput("facetsUI"),
    DT::dataTableOutput("panelSelect")
  )
)

server.R:

library(ggplot2)

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) { 
  df <- data.frame(x = 1:12, y = 1:12, f = rep(1:4, 3)) 
  F1 <- function() {
    ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
      geom_point(shape = 19, alpha = 0.4, size = 4) +
      facet_wrap(~ f)
  }
  output$facetsPlot <- renderPlot(res = 90, {
    F1()
  })
  output$facetsUI <-renderUI ({
    plotOutput("facetsPlot",
               brush = brushOpts(id = "panelBrush"))
  })
  output$panelSelect <- DT::renderDataTable({
    DT::datatable(brushedPoints(df, input$panelBrush),
                  options = list(searching = F, lengthChange = F, pageLength = 5,
                                 columnDefs = list(list(className = 'dt-center', targets = "_all"))),
                  class = 'cell-border stripe', rownames = F)
  })
})

Brush works properly showing the table without the facet_wrap (and without the + of the line above it), but with that line it shows the plot properly but doesn't let you brush. With facet_grid happens the same. It might be happening since the update to ggplot2 2.0.0 because I have an app using this and it used to work but I am not sure if it stopped working before or after the ggplot2 update. Anyway I found nothing about this at github.com/hadley/ggplot2/issues or in the forums here or at stackoverflow.

Thank you,
Angel
